children: Caterpillar will deploy its autonomous hauling tech at two additional Luck Stone quarries in Virginia, marking its first use on Cat 775 trucks. The move follows 18+ months at Bull Run, where autonomous trucks hauled over 3.5M tons since November 2024.
Autonomy to two more VA quarries
Signals commercialization beyond pilot, supporting adoption and potential revenue growth in Resource Industries.
Extends addressable market in quarry segment by enabling a widely used haul truck model.
Demonstrates operating proof at Bull Run, reducing execution risk for broader rollout.
Scale track record supports customer confidence and competitive moat in autonomy.

This is a mid-cycle confirmation of CAT’s push to commercialize autonomy in quarries, moving from pilot to multi-site deployment. A larger catalyst would be broader customer wins, quantified orders, or revenue/KPI disclosures tied to autonomy adoption.
